So, what's so 'good' about this, to be honest, it's not the best out there, just it's free and it works pretty good, it doesn't use TweenService either. It also destroys other players blocks (Only for you), so they can't set up a seat trap and break it, or something like that. You can AFK overnight or while your not home, and when you come back, you should expect to have a decent amount of gold and gold blocks. You can also setup a webhook to check whenever you want! This is part of a bigger project, Project: TRASH, pretty much a script hub for games with trash anticheats, or 'bad'. For some reason this doesn't work with Awp.gg seems to be because of Rayfeild, and not my script. For macsploit it seems to break every hour or so, but it works fine on Seliware, and should work fine on xeno too. This script doesn't require much unc either, so you can use it on a low unc executor. If you have any questions or issues, please let me know on discord: bigblueno0b

Enjoy!
